title: LogicalApplicationComponent
description: TOGAF-sourced structural archetype — logical encapsulation of application functionality, independent of implementation technology. Extends Structure with TOGAF Application Architecture vocabulary. TOGAF mapping: Logical Application Component (Content Metamodel, Application Architecture domain). Source framework: TOGAF (Application Architecture, Content Framework).

functionalDomain.description: Business functionality domain this component encapsulates (e.g., 'order-management', 'identity', 'analytics'). TOGAF mapping: Logical Application Component functional scope.

architectureTier.description: Tier in the layered architecture model. TOGAF mapping: position in the Application Architecture reference model.
